data.desc: Artiva is a clinical-stage biotechnology company that has focused on developing allogeneic natural killer (NK) cell therapies for autoimmune diseases. AlloNK (AB-101), the Company's lead development candidate, is a non-genetically modified, allogeneic, cryopreserved NK cell therapy that was evaluated in combination with B-cell-targeted monoclonal antibodies. Artiva is headquartered in San Diego, California.
